title: Yarn whitelists a host for unencrypted traffic
description: .yarnrc.yml declares a host on the `unsafeHttpWhitelist`, which Yarn will talk to over cleartext. Every package fetched from a whitelisted host forgoes transport authentication, so its bytes can be replaced in flight.
remediation: Serve those hosts over https and empty the whitelist.
limitation: It matches a host on the `unsafeHttpWhitelist`, which Yarn will talk to over cleartext in the parsed .yarnrc.yml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
